proves.claim: Opening a new item folder with no spare launches at most 3 git processes, counted by wrapping node:child_process.

cli.item-folder.new-folder-git-launches.why: Without it, a regression that adds git launches back to the claiming next's slowest stage would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: A new item folder has the expected path, branch, checked-out commit and seat marker for both a new branch and an existing branch.

cli.item-folder.same-folder-new-and-exis.why: Without it, reading the branch and primary checkout from files instead of git could change the folder opened and pass unnoticed.
